title: 第七章 这就是扭转命运的钥匙
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
“干得漂亮，小子。”
看着方正，拉姆福德队长露出了欣慰的笑容，他伸出手去，用力拍了拍方正的肩膀，这才望向他身边的圣教军。
“谢谢你的帮助，现在你可以进去了，莉娅在屠牛旅馆，方正可以带你去………你怎么了？小子？”
“没什么，拉姆福德队长。”
听到拉姆福德关心的询问，方正郁闷的耸耸肩膀，然后开口说道。他现在真后悔自己刚才的想法，本来方正还以为这个系统下达的任务虽然麻烦了一些，危险了一些，可好歹也算是任务目标明确。但让方正没有想到的是，《守护者》任务的第三阶段居然如此坑爹！
改变命运！
一想到任务要求，方正就郁闷的不行，这些系统刷新出来的任务全是随机的，他根本没有印象，而且任务提示本身没有给出线索，只要求方正改变既定的命运。但究竟具体内容是什么，一概没有说明。不仅如此，系统还特地提示，这个任务如果失败就会强制退出任务世界，而且还很“贴心”的附赠了倒计时。于是这下可好，方正只有四十八个小时去改变这所谓的“命运”………本来方正还打算跟在奈非天身边刷刷刷呢，现在看起来，这果然不可能啊。
“请跟我来吧。”
想到这里，方正强打起精神，对着身边的圣教军点了点头，接着便举步走进了小镇。
一路上两人并没有多说什么，如果有时间的话，方正倒是想要看看“官方”的奈非天究竟是个什么样的人。不过现在他可没有这个心情来浪费时间，任务第三阶段只给了自己四十八个小时的时间，而关于这个命运，方正还一点儿头绪都没有。
这也是方正对于暗黑3的剧情实在记不太清楚了，不过这也难怪，当你每天都沉迷于大秘境之后，暗黑在讲什么对于玩家来说真是一点儿都不重要了，在那之前先刷个套装才是真的………
当方正带着圣教军来到屠牛旅馆时，一眼就看见了正在柜台前愁眉不展的莉娅。这个一头短发的妹子此刻正坐在椅子上，低声和老板说着些什么。而看见方正推门进来，老板也是立刻中断了和莉娅的谈话，热情的冲着他招了招手。
“小子！你又救了我们一次！来，这杯算我请你的………这位小姐又是谁？”
听到老板的询问，方正身边的圣教军走上前来，她伸出手拿下头盔，露出了一张充满英气的面孔，一头金黄色的长发束成一缕马尾搭在肩膀上，她先是温和的对着旅馆老板笑了笑，然后望向莉娅。
“你好，莉娅小姐，我是信奉萨卡兰姆的圣教军，我叫艾瑞贝丝…………”
我了个去！
走到柜台前的方正听到这句话差点儿没把手中的酒给洒出去，他转过头来，惊疑不定的望着眼前的圣教军———这位奈非天，你这发型和名字都很不吉利啊！
我已经看见结局了有没有？
先别说别的，方正觉得首先让这位圣教军小姐改个名字和发型才是真的，这样一来自己的任务估计也能够轻而易举的完成了………才怪呢。
那么难道是莉娅？

想到这里，方正再次望向那个年轻的少女，他当然知道这个少女体内就隐藏着邪神，而最终邪神也会借助她的身体复活。按照道理来说，如果方正这会儿直接一剑砍死她，那么也算是改变了命运。然而………这可能吗？
先不说莉娅自己就是一个战斗职业者，她身体内邪神的力量同样可怕，哪怕方正出其不意的偷袭，也绝对不会蒙蔽邪神的眼睛。万一把它逼急了，那么方正也讨不到好去。所以这个念头在方正脑中只是转了一圈，就立刻被他放下了。
就在这个时候，艾瑞贝丝已经开始向莉娅询问关于那从天而降的陨星的事情，而莉娅也像游戏之中一样对这位奈非天进行了说明，同时请求她去找找自己的叔叔………迪卡凯恩…………嗯？
听到这里，方正忽然眼前一亮。
对了，自己怎么忽略了这么一个重要人物，迪卡凯恩！
如果方正没有记错的话，迪卡凯恩被邪教首领玛格妲威胁，要他修复天使泰瑞尔断裂的圣剑，然而凯恩誓死不从，被玛格妲的手下打成重伤。而接着莉娅爆发了自己的力量，赶跑了玛格妲一行。最终凯恩拼尽了最后一点儿力气复原了圣剑，但是他自己也因为油尽灯枯而最终丧命。

content_en:
"Good job, boy."
Looking at Fang Zheng, Captain Rumford showed a pleased smile. He reached out and patted Fang Zheng on the shoulder, and then looked at the Crusaders beside him.
"Thank you for your help. You can go in now. Leah is at the Cow Slaughter Hotel. Founder can take you there... What's wrong with you, kid?"
"Nothing, Captain Rumford."
Upon hearing Rumford's concerned inquiry, Fang Zheng shrugged his shoulders depressedly, and then spoke. He really regretted his thoughts now. Originally, Fang Zheng thought that although the tasks assigned by this system were a little more troublesome and dangerous, they still had clear mission goals. But what Fang Zheng didn't expect was that the third stage of the "Guardian" mission would be so deceptive!
Change your destiny!
When he thought about the mission requirements, Fang Zheng became extremely depressed. The missions refreshed by these systems were all random and he had no impression at all. Moreover, the mission prompt itself gave no clues and only asked Fang Zheng to change his established destiny. But what the specific content is has not been explained at all. Not only that, the system also specifically reminds you that if you fail this task, you will be forced to exit the task world, and it also comes with a countdown that is very "intimate". So now it's good, Fang Zheng only has forty-eight hours to change this so-called "destiny"... Originally Fang Zheng had planned to follow Nephalem around, but now it seems that this is really impossible.
"Please come with me."
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng cheered up, nodded to the Crusaders beside him, and then walked into the town.
The two of them didn't say much along the way. If he had time, Fang Zheng would like to see what kind of person the "official" Nephalem is. But now he was not in the mood to waste time. He was only given forty-eight hours in the third phase of the mission, and Fang Zheng had no clue about this fate.
This is because Founder really doesn’t remember the plot of Diablo 3 very clearly, but it’s no wonder. When you are addicted to the Great Secret Realm every day, what Diablo is talking about is really not important to the players at all. Before that, it’s really important to brush up the suit...
When Fang Zheng led the Crusaders to the Cow Slaughter Hotel, he immediately saw Leah, who was frowning in front of the counter. This girl with short hair was sitting on a chair at the moment, whispering something to her boss. When he saw Fang Zheng pushing the door in, the boss immediately interrupted his conversation with Leah and waved to him enthusiastically.
"Boy! You saved us again! Come on, I'll treat you to this drink...Who is this lady?"
Hearing the boss's inquiry, the Crusader beside Fang Zheng stepped forward. She reached out and took off her helmet, revealing a heroic face, with long golden hair tied into a ponytail and draped over her shoulders. She first smiled gently at the hotel owner, and then looked at Leah.
"Hello, Miss Leia, I am a Crusader who believes in Zakarum. My name is Irebeth..."
I'm going!
Fang Zheng, who was walking to the counter, almost spilled the wine in his hand when he heard these words. He turned his head and looked at the Crusaders in front of him in surprise - this Nephalem, your hairstyle and name are very unlucky!
Have I seen the ending?
Let alone anything else, Fang Zheng felt that it would be true to ask this Crusader lady to change her name and hairstyle first. In this way, his mission would probably be completed easily... It would be strange.
So is it Leah?
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng looked at the young girl again. Of course he knew that the evil god was hidden in this girl's body, and that the evil god would eventually be resurrected with the help of her body. Logically speaking, if Fang Zheng killed her with a sword right now, it would be regarded as changing his fate. However...is this possible?
Let’s not talk about Li firstYa herself is a combat professional, and the power of the evil god in her body is equally terrifying. Even if Fang Zheng makes a surprise attack, it will never blind the eyes of the evil god. If it is forced into a hurry, Fangzheng will not be able to get any relief. So this idea just turned around in Fang Zheng's mind, and he immediately put it down.
At this time, Aribeth had already begun to ask Leah about the meteor that fell from the sky, and Leah also explained the Nephalem just like in the game, and asked her to find her uncle... Deckard Cain... Huh?
Hearing this, Fang Zheng's eyes suddenly lit up.
By the way, why did I ignore such an important person, Deckard Cain!
If Founder remembers correctly, Deckard Kane was threatened by the cult leader Magda and asked him to repair the broken holy sword of the angel Tyrell. However, Kane refused to obey and was seriously injured by Magda's men. Then Leah exploded with her own power and drove away Magda and her party. In the end, Kane used his last bit of strength to restore the holy sword, but he himself eventually died because the oil ran out.
